x_snc_airop_check_definition.ai_justification: HR case relationships (parent cases, related incidents, linked tasks) provide context Now Assist uses for comprehensive case summarization. Isolated cases without relationships limit AI summary depth.
x_snc_airop_check_definition.remediation_guidance: Encourage HR agents to link related cases, incidents, and tasks using the Related Records tab. Configure automation to auto-link related HR cases by employee. Now Assist HRSD summarization improves with relationship context.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_snc_airop_check_definition"><x_snc_airop_check_definition action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><ai_justification><![CDATA[HR case relationships (parent cases, related incidents, linked tasks) provide context Now Assist uses for comprehensive case summarization. Isolated cases without relationships limit AI summary depth.]]></ai_justification><check_name>HR Case Related Records</check_name><check_script><![CDATA[(function(checkDef, dateFilter) {
    var ga = new GlideAggregate('task_rel_task');
    ga.addEncodedQuery('parent.sys_class_name=sn_hr_core_case^ORchild.sys_class_name=sn_hr_core_case');
    ga.addAggregate('COUNT');
    ga.query();
    var count = ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT')) : 0;

    var actualValue = count + ' HR case relationships in task_rel_task';

    if (count >= 50) {
        return {
            status: 'ready',
            actualValue: actualValue,
            finding: count + ' HR case relationships. Now Assist HRSD summarization has rich relationship context for comprehensive AI-generated case summaries.'
        };
    } else if (count >= 10) {
        return {
            status: 'needs_attention',
            actualValue: actualValue,
            finding: 'Only ' + count + ' HR case relationships (target: 50+). Now Assist HRSD summarization will have limited relationship context for AI summary depth.'
        };
    } else {
        return {
            status: 'not_ready',
            actualValue: actualValue,
            finding: 'Only ' + count + ' HR case relationships. Now Assist HRSD summarization uses related records for comprehensive context — encourage agents to link related cases and tasks.'
        };
    }
})]]></check_script><is_active>true</is_active><is_clone_sensitive>false</is_clone_sensitive><is_manual>false</is_manual><module>HRSD</module><number>CHK0002601</number><order>180</order><remediation_guidance>Encourage HR agents to link related cases, incidents, and tasks using the Related Records tab.
